_description: The FITTED deep-time inputs of the ESSRT rotation history — the frozen record of three fits, banked here (plan 11 step 1) when public/input/model-parameters.json retired. Each value is the SHIPPED double, bit-identical to the model-parameters deepTime block it left; every runtime reads it through the generated constants module (tools/constants/generate.mjs assembles DEFAULT_CONSTANTS.deepTime from this file, astro-reference.json and data/deltaT-4flag-fit.json). Not a parameter anyone types: a refit is a CAMPAIGN under the 41-anchor paleo gate (tools/verify/paleo-anchors.js, where an unexplained improvement fails too), and no fit here is reproduced by a live instrument in the tree — see each value's provenance.

meta.generator: none — a banked fitted record (plan 11 step 1); the fitters that produced these values are named per value below

_alphaNote: a_Moon(t)/a_now = 1 + α₁·t + α₃·t³ + α₄·t⁴ (t in Myr before J2000; no α₂, so the modern LLR rate is preserved). α₁ is the LLR-anchored INPUT (astro-reference moonReference.moonRecessionAlpha1PerMa); α₃ and α₄ are the least-squares fit to the Farhat et al. 2022 deep-time recession anchors. The fitter was a one-off of the Driver-1 campaign (2026-07) and is not in the tree; the pair is validated live by paleo-anchors.js (Wells 1963 / Wu 2024 era, ≤ 1000 Ma — the regime below keeps the quartic bit-identical there).
_alphaGiaRelaxationNote: τ of the GIA channel — the LAGGED response of Earth's polar moment to the ice history the climate formula's L1 proxies (@essrt/physics climate/l1-orbital createAlphaGiaChannel). MEASURED against the historical ΔT record through the joint ΔT fitter (plan 06 D7, 2026-09-20): optimum 5–6 kyr, the degree-2 Maxwell estimate; the coupling k is DERIVED at runtime from the Cox & Chao rate (astro-reference giaCoxChaoPeltier), so no scale is stored. The τ scan was a plan-06 instrument, since deleted; the eclipse-audit and lunar-alignment campaigns record what the shipped τ does.

recessionRegime._description: Driver 1½ regime-aware lunar recession (2026-08-14, commit acddb6b5): the quartic stays BIT-IDENTICAL ≤ jointMa (the Wells/Wu-gated era — its alpha set is the calibrated effective closed-budget pair); beyond, a monotone cubic Hermite through the fitted knots to the rigid Roche limit at genesisMa, plus the two explicit solar angular-momentum channels (ocean leak beta0·(a/a0)^6·tau_moon; insolation-driven thermal-tide pump factor·(tau_moon+leak) inside the window — Zahnle-Walker 1987 / Bartlett-Stevenson 2016 / Mitchell-Kirscher 2023, Zhou 2024's contrary reading recorded). Fit: tools/explore/fit-regime-recession.js against 11 published anchors (Lantink 2022 Joffre · Weeli Wolli · Zhou 2024 ×3 paired a+LOD · Meyers-Malinverno 2018 Xiamaling · Nanfen 2023 · Moodies via Farhat 2022), all ≤1.3σ; genesis PINNED at the shipped 4498 Ma Roche crossing (the genesis chi² profile is flat — the data do not constrain it); pump factor 2.4σ preferred over zero, with the factor×window product the constrained quantity (0.454×~300 Myr ≈ 0.15×~900 Myr degeneracy recorded). Knot values are the shipped definition (metre-rounded at fit time). Consumed via @essrt/physics deltat/recession-history.
recessionRegime._reproductionNote: MEASURED (plan 12 step 1, 2026-10-18; this replaces the plan-11 note, which attributed the gap to plan 09 — wrongly): the fitter named above, as committed in acddb6b5 together with this block, has always preferred knots 337,812 / 321,752 / 320,277 / 296,313 / 288,738 km and a pump of 0.144 over 1000–1885 Ma with genesis pinned at 4498 — run from git archives at acddb6b5 itself and at plan 09 steps 3, 5c, 5d, 7b it returns that solution to the printed digit (its seed is fixed; its engine inputs moved only at step 3, by parts per billion). These values were therefore never that fitter's committed output: they came from an uncommitted same-day run on 2026-08-14. The two solutions are one degenerate family (factor × window 0.139 vs 0.127 Gyr, every anchor ≤ 1.2σ in both; the 3.9-Ga knot has no anchor). The paleo-anchors gate passes 43/43 on either. This block stays the shipped record until plan 12 adopts a candidate from the governed fitter tools/fit/fit-regime-recession.js.
